evidence_quotes.quote: Alternative Hierarchies: The Anatomy of Bureaucracies and the Perspective of Their Self-Defeat in West and East
Bureaucratic organizations, both in Western state capitalism & in Soviet & Chinese state socialism, have reached the limits of their growth

One way to achieve this is the democratic job reform now taking place in a number of countries, which enables people to organize work on a flexible & small-scale basis apart from traditional bureaucracy.
